drafts.walkScript: The card says hot. Hot means having a lot of heat. Cold means having very little heat, so cold is the opposite. Warm is only a little less hot. Spicy can mean hot, and wet is about water.
The card says high. High means a long way up. Low means not far up at all, so low is the opposite. Tall and towering mean much the same as high. Steep describes a slope, not how far up.
